svg.aria-label: 4 square panels in one row, each plotting every model measured on both of two environments at its within-environment standardized score in one against the other, on a shared axis with the y equals x diagonal drawn. A point off the diagonal is a model that stands in a different place in the two columns. Each panel names the models furthest from the diagonal, in an empty region of its own panel, joined to its point by a thin line in the model's colour. Kendall tau-b and shared-model count per pair: Seaquest (Atari ALE with ARI) vs HalfCheetah (MuJoCo) (weakest environment): tau 0.153, n=16; Pursuit (Predator) (MAgent2) vs Breakout (Atari ALE with ARI) (real spread): tau 0.443, n=32; Connect Four (MO) (MOMAland) vs Connect Four (Adapted) (real spread): tau 0.614, n=19; Hopper (MuJoCo) vs Four Rooms (MiniGrid) (real spread): tau 0.589, n=19.
